items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mr. Jones is not a – I don’t think we sat and did it. That’s a lot of percussionists there. Frank Ippolito was there.

ctx.x: He was – his heroes were jazz musicians, because jazz musicians could think on their feet and were much more flexible and could change directions rapidly.

Yeah, we’re becoming the model, and we’re becoming a corporate model now. Guys going out and giving these clinics, right?, how to hit a conga drum, because, feel your inner Jones, make up the thing. Oh, be a little looser in your stuff. Yeah, there are a lot of great qualities to this music that are intrinsic to learning the music. But it’s more than that. It’s the lifestyle. I don’t mean the negative part. That’s understood. We got that. Bird, the movie, took care of that. It’s the positive, life-affirming…
That’s right. There was a reason why the Nazis hated jazz.
